question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **When**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to fill in the blank is **When**. 
 
• In the given sentence, When is used as a** relative pronoun** in the relative clauses which are I had just left for school and I was caught in a heavy storm. 
 
• Relative pronouns introduce relative clauses that **describe nouns or other pronouns.**

 The correct sentence is:** It was a cloudy morning. I had just left for school when I was caught in a heavy storm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Though** means 'despite the fact'

 
 
• ​**Example**: *I still feel like eating even though I had my dinner just now. *
 
 
 
• **Then **is used to refer either to the past or the future. 
 
 
• ​**Example**: *What age he was then?*
 
 
 
• **Since **is used to refer to a particular time in the past. 
 
 
• ​**Example**: *I have lived in Delhi since 2002.*
